course.description: fix: it blocks the reporting step, is related or is critical - the run's recovery fixes it at its root now. next: a defect in code the run's change does not touch that blocks nothing - it becomes a work item of the run's next round, listed and started first, built beside the rest, and nothing of this round is held for it. list: none of these holds - it is listed, proven, and shown in the pull request's body and the handoff. duplicate: the issues the run took before it hold it, and duplicates names its id. unproven: you could not reproduce it on the base commit - it is not listed. join: it is another issue, whose root cause is that of one taken before it that is being triaged, being fixed or fixed, and joins names that one's id - its fix is that issue's, which settles both, or, where that fix is done already, a fix of its own told what that one did.

title.description: One line a person who never saw the run understands: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong, where, and what it causes, from what your proof shows and nothing else.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command, where the issue is.

proof.description: What you read or ran on the base commit that shows the issue.

kind.description: read: you read a file at the base commit. ran: you ran a command there. none: you could not reproduce it, and the course is unproven.

at.description: The base commit you checked it at.

file.description: For read, the path from the repository's root; otherwise empty.

lines.description: For read, the lines, as 12-19; otherwise empty.

quote.description: For read, those lines word for word; otherwise empty.

command.description: For ran, the command word for word; otherwise empty.

output.description: For ran, what it printed that shows the issue, word for word; for none, what you tried; otherwise empty.

blocks.description: True only where the reporting step said it stops its own work and your check confirms it.

size.description: For next, the issue's size, which its work item is built to: the files the fix touches, what must be built, and what must be measured first. Each empty where the course is not next.

files.description: The files fixing it touches, from the repository's root; for next, one at least.

build.description: What must be built to fix it; empty where nothing must.

measureFirst.description: What must be measured before it is fixed, as the measure tool takes each; empty where nothing must.

related.description: True where the issue is in a path the plan's items change or depend on, or in the behaviour the request asks for.

critical.description: True where, on the base commit, it loses data, opens a security hole, crashes, or keeps the build or the tests from passing.

why.description: Why the course: which test held and what shows it; for list, that none held.

duplicates.description: For duplicate, the id of the issue it repeats, taken before it; otherwise empty.

joins.description: For join, the id of the issue taken before it, being triaged, being fixed or fixed, whose root cause it shares; otherwise empty.
